subject: Important Update: Meeting Rescheduled
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. I would like to inform you that the upcoming team meeting scheduled for tomorrow has been rescheduled to next week Thursday at 10:00 AM. Please make a note of this change in your calendar. If you have any conflicts with the new timing, please let me know as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
